newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo firms on mark, lira may be helping.
newsitem.headline: Escudo firms on mark, lira may be helping.

text.p: The escudo was gaining against the mark in early trade and traders said that the return of the Italian lira to the European Monetary System's Exchange Rate Mechanism might be helping to lift the Portuguese currency.
But the main factor was the dollar's strengthening against the German unit, they added.
Traders saw the escudo trading at between 100.85 and 101.00 to the mark on Monday. At 0841 GMT, it was trading at 100.92/95.
